create_confidence_sampler: create a DensePoseConfidenceBasedSampler instance with a specified confidence channel and count per class
produce_index_sample: produce a sample of indices from a tensor based on confidence value estimates
produce_labels_and_results: produce DensePose segmentation labels and UV results with confidence from a predictor instance
configure_search_multiplier: configure the sampler to use search_count_multiplier for selecting the most confident estimates
configure_search_proportion: configure the sampler to use search_proportion for selecting the most confident estimates
